beatLines.line: 🍽️ You wave off the second scoop and nod toward Aroha. 'Aroha eats first tonight.' Nobody at the fire disagrees.
🍽️ Thin day. Your bowl stays half-full — the other half goes to An, who's been quiet about being hungry.
🍽️ You push half your bowl across the fire to Greta — 'eat. You need it more than I do.' Greta doesn't argue. The bowl comes back scraped clean.
🍽️ The bins are thin, and Leo looks it. You set your second half in front of Leo. 'Eat,' you say. Leo eats like someone making up for days.
